mass cytometry for cellular phenotyping.readouts: single-cell expression of 37 immune cell surface markers and CHIKV envelope protein E2; cell population and sub-community frequencies; median marker expression patterns

evidence.quote: All selected cases had an acute-phase sample collected on days 1–2 of illness and a convalescent sample collected on days 15–17 post-illness for serum, whole blood in PAXgene solution, and PBMCs; these were subject to transcriptomic analysis via RNA-seq, CHIKV viral titer assays, multiplex ELISA for cytokines, and mass cytometry for cellular phenotyping as illustrated in Fig 1 .

multiplex ELISA.readouts: concentrations of 40 cytokines, chemokines, and growth factors; mean fluorescence data from bead-based multiplex panels

evidence.quote: Forty analytes (cytokines and chemokines) were measured using a Luminex‐200 system and the XMap Platform (Luminex Corporation).

CHIKV viral titer assays.standard_technique_name: real time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction

evidence.quote: Primers for the E1 gene were designed to quantify CHIKV copies in each patient and were used at 300 nM final concentration.
